paper_title: ADMX SLIC: Results from a Superconducting LC Circuit Investigating Cold Axions
notes: ADMX SLIC pilot LC-circuit haloscope search for axion-photon coupling. New measured exclusion limits over three narrow mass windows: 1.7498-1.7519e-7 eV (42.31-42.36 MHz, 4.5 T), 1.7734-1.7738e-7 eV (42.88-42.89 MHz, 5.0 T), 1.8007-1.8015e-7 eV (43.54-43.56 MHz, 7.0 T). The paper presents exclusion curves only graphically (Fig. 4); the abstract states 'exclusion results for coupling below 10^-12 GeV^-1', so an approximate flat value of 1e-12 GeV^-1 is used for each of the three covered windows (encoded as three two-point segments). Actual limit curves vary within each window and are somewhat stronger with RFI candidates eliminated (orange curves, treated as estimates only). DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm^3 is the standard ADMX halo assumption; not explicitly stated in the provided text. Confidence level not explicitly stated in the excerpt; 90% assumed per ADMX convention.
